criteria.detail: 7,951 adjacent pairs. midpoint share: worst |w(j,k)+w(k,j)| = 4.441e-16. base-period share: 1.497e-01. Half of this criterion has to fail and it is the base-period half: a weight that is not symmetric in the endpoints does not give a cochain, so nothing can be built on it.
criteria.name: B101-2  the edge function is antisymmetric, and the base-share form is not

criteria.detail: chaining the published bilateral formula and sweeping the area in (ln(L/K), alpha) are computed without a shared step, and the second never reads Y. Worst difference by window: n=2: 9.992e-16, n=3: 5.967e-16, n=5: 7.598e-16, n=10: 9.021e-16, n=26: 1.166e-15
criteria.name: B101-1  the closed form: the chained index equals the swept area

criteria.detail: counts printed, no threshold on an estimator. Non-zero above 1e-12 by window: n=2: 99.8% of 20,206, n=3: 99.8% of 19,169, n=5: 99.8% of 17,125, n=10: 99.8% of 12,247, n=26: 100.0% of 445. Median |drift| runs 2.588e-04 at n=2 to 9.481e-03 at n=26. Floor measured not declared: a relative shock of 1e-2 to every published quantity moves the n=10 median by a factor 1.05, and the construction floor is 1.665e-16, so the reading stands 1.7e+13 times above it.
criteria.name: B101-4  within one country-industry the chained index does not equal the direct one

criteria.detail: sigma = a + b*ln(K/L) is affine in the log mix along every path inside a series, whatever fits the two coefficients, so the trapezoid sum telescopes. Smoothed: n=2: median 8.327e-17, 0.0% non-zero, n=3: median 9.368e-17, 0.0% non-zero, n=5: median 1.110e-16, 0.0% non-zero, n=10: median 1.665e-16, 0.0% non-zero, n=26: median 2.220e-16, 0.0% non-zero. This is the algebra checked on the panel rather than on synthetic cells, and it is also the reading: the smoothing sets the drift to zero rather than lowering it.
criteria.name: B101-5  under GRV's own share form the drift is not reduced, it is exactly zero

criteria.cite: Griffith, Redding & Van Reenen 2004, Review of Economics and Statistics 86(4): 883-895, equation 9 and the share-smoothing paragraph
criteria.detail: the point prediction is exact zero and it fails in 99.8% of 12,247 ten-year windows, and in 100.0% of the twenty-six-year ones.

grid_note.A: the index-number literature knows that chained indices drift and measures it, which B79 already recorded as an A-cell reading and this does not change. What is not in that literature is the next criterion: their share smoothing does not reduce the drift, it sets it to exactly zero.
grid_note.B: per 0b, the two readings written separately before the cell is named. Ours: no scalar on the cells reproduces the observed edges, so a closed path does not return to where it started. Theirs: a translog technology makes the share affine in the log mix, so it does. Reality on this panel: non-zero in 99.8% of ten-year windows and 100% of twenty-six-year ones. Ours holds, theirs does not, so B.

criteria.name: B101-6  a translog technology makes this index transitive
criteria.rival_entailment: an affine share makes the trapezoid sum around any closed path telescope exactly, so the chained index equals the direct index over the same window to machine precision
criteria.rival_premise: value added is A*Phi(L,K) with Phi translog, so each factor's share of value added is affine in the log factor ratio
